answer: The protocol ties each agent’s stake to a trellis of overlapping juror panels, and every block a pulse of median‑scored decisions is broadcast; any juror whose vote diverges from the panel median by more than a calibrated offset is automatically slashed, burning the ember of their bonded stake. An attacker must post a separate bond for every synthetic identity, wait the full challenge period, and then forfeit that bond if any panel flags divergence, costing ≥ 1 POA token per fake identity.
